title: $p$-adic Sum-Product, Projections, and Furstenberg Sets
summary: Let $p$ be a prime number. We prove the sharp Furstenberg set bound in the $p$-adic plane $\mathbb{Q}_p^2$: every $(s,t)$-Furstenberg set $E\subset\mathbb{Q}_p^2$ satisfies $$ \dim_H E\ge \min\left\{s+t,\frac{3s+t}{2},s+1\right\}. $$ This matches the sharp lower bound in the Euclidean plane.
